passages.text: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
passages.sermon: Sons, listen to your father's instruction.\r\nPay attention.\r\nGain understanding.
passages.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה׃

passages.text: For I give you sound teaching; do not abandon my directive.
passages.sermon:
I am a father.
I give you good teaching.
My teaching is wise and true.
Do not leave my instruction.
Hold on to my command.
passages.original: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל־ תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃

passages.text: When I was a son to my father, tender and the only child of my mother, he taught me and said, “Let your heart lay hold of my words; keep my commands and you will live.
passages.sermon:
I was a son to my father.
I was tender.
I was the only child of my mother.
My father taught me.
He said to me, "Let your heart hold on to my words."
He said, "Keep my commands."
He said, "You will live."
passages.original: כִּי־ בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃ וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ־ דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה׃

passages.text: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
passages.sermon:
Seek wisdom.
Seek understanding.
Do not forget my words.
Do not turn away from what I say.
passages.original: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל־ תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃

passages.text: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom is very important.
Do not leave wisdom.
Wisdom will keep you safe.
Love wisdom.
Wisdom will protect you.
passages.original: אַל־ תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom is most important.
Get wisdom.
Understanding is also important.
Get understanding with everything you have.
passages.original: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־ קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה׃

passages.text: Prize her, and she will exalt you; if you embrace her, she will honor you.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom is valuable.
Prize wisdom.
Wisdom will lift you up.
Embrace wisdom.
Wisdom will honor you.
passages.original: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: She will set a garland of grace on your head; she will present you with a crown of beauty.”
passages.sermon:
Wisdom is a woman in this passage.
Wisdom will place a garland of grace on your head.
Wisdom will give you a crown of beauty.
Wisdom will honor you if you value her.
passages.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־ חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Listen, my son, and receive my words, and the years of your life will be many.
passages.sermon:
A father speaks to his son.
He says, "Listen to me, my son."
He tells his son to accept his words.
If you listen and accept my words, you will live many years.
Your life will be long.
passages.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: I will guide you in the way of wisdom; I will lead you on straight paths.
passages.sermon:
I will guide you.
I will guide you in the way of wisdom.
I will lead you.
I will lead you on straight paths.
I will show you how to live with wisdom.
I will direct you to do what is right.
passages.original: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־ יֹֽשֶׁר׃

passages.text: When you walk, your steps will not be impeded; when you run, you will not stumble.
passages.sermon:
A wise father speaks to his son.
He teaches his son to follow wisdom.
He promises safety to his son.
When you walk, nothing will block your steps.
When you run, you will not fall.
passages.original: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־ יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם־ תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃

passages.text: Hold on to instruction; do not let go. Guard it, for it is your life.
passages.sermon:
Instruction gives wisdom and guidance.
Hold on to instruction.
Do not let go of it.
Guard instruction carefully.
Instruction is your life.
passages.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־ תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי־ הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
passages.sermon: Do not enter the path of wicked people.\r\nDo not walk in the way of those who do evil.
passages.original: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל־ תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל־ תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים׃

passages.text: Avoid it; do not travel on it. Turn from it and pass on by.
passages.sermon:
God warns you about the path of the wicked.
Do not go on that path.
Stay away from it.
Do not walk on it.
Turn aside from it.
Keep going past it.
Do not let it become your way.
passages.original: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־ תַּעֲבָר־ בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר׃

passages.text: For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; they are deprived of slumber until they make someone fall.
passages.sermon:
The wicked are people who do evil.
They cannot sleep unless they do evil.
They lose their sleep if they do not cause someone to stumble.
They must harm others before they can rest.
They stay awake until they make someone fall.
passages.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם־ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם־ לֹ֥א יִכְשׁוֹלוּ׃

passages.text: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people do evil things.
They take part in wrongdoing.
They eat the bread of wickedness.
They drink the wine of violence.
They fill their lives with evil and harm.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃

passages.text: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
passages.sermon:
The righteous walk a special path.
This path is bright like the first light of morning.
The light grows stronger as time passes.
It shines more and more until the day is full.
passages.original: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד־ נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.
passages.sermon:
The wicked walk in darkness.
Their path is full of gloom.
They do not understand why they fall.
They do not see what causes them to stumble.
passages.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃פ

passages.text: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
passages.sermon:
A father speaks to his son.
He says, "My son, listen to my words."
He says, "Pay close attention to what I say."
He says, "Turn your ear toward my sayings."
He urges his son to hear and understand his teachings.
passages.original: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט־ אָזְנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.
passages.sermon: Do not let my words leave your sight.\r\nKeep my words inside your heart.
passages.original: אַל־ יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
passages.sermon: God’s words give life to those who find them.\r\nGod’s words bring health to the whole body.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל־ בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃

passages.text: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
passages.sermon:
Guard your heart carefully.
Be diligent in protecting it.
Your heart is the source of life.
Life’s springs flow from your heart.
passages.original: מִֽכָּל־ מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
passages.sermon:
Do not speak with a twisted mouth.
Remove deception from your words.
Do not let your lips speak perverse things.
Keep false and corrupt speech far from you.
passages.original: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
passages.sermon: Look forward with your eyes.\r\nKeep your gaze straight ahead.
passages.original: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
passages.sermon:
You must choose a straight path for your feet.
You must make your way clear and level.
If you do this, all your ways will be secure.
Your steps will be steady and firm.
passages.original: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־ דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He gives a command.
Do not turn to the right.
Do not turn to the left.
Keep your feet away from evil.
Walk only in the good path.
passages.original: אַֽל־ תֵּט־ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃
